claims.claim: Karpathy queried models 16,200 times across a coordinate grid and rendered answers as an image matching real geography.
claims.episode_span: Andrej Karpathy showed that large language models can correctly classify land versus water when given only latitude and longitude as text. The evaluation queried models 16,200 times across a grid and rendered the answers as an image that closely matches real geography.
claims.source_title: Cool eval showing LLMs know land vs water from lat/long text coords
claims.supporting_quote: Cool eval. Simply ask an LLM “Land or Water?” and give it a latitude and longitude coordinate as text. Ask 16,200 times, plot as image. The models know.

claims.claim: Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 GraphForge trajectories raised GDPVal to 1445.7 under OpenHands.
claims.episode_span: Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 trajectories raised GDPVal to 1445.7 under OpenHands and improved Workspace-Bench-Lite and SpreadsheetBench II scores.
claims.source_title: GraphForge: Training Working Agents with Graph-Anchored Workspace Synthesis
claims.supporting_quote: Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 GraphForge trajectories brings GDPVal to 1445.7 (+65.7) under OpenHands, and Workspace-Bench-Lite and SpreadsheetBench II to 63.7 (+7.7) and 24.0 (+13.7) under Claude Code.

claims.claim: Settle cut token count by forty percent on MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B while accuracy dropped only half a percentage point.
claims.episode_span: On MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B it cut token count by forty percent while accuracy dropped only half a percentage point.
claims.source_title: Settle: Learning When to Stop Reasoning
claims.supporting_quote: On MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B, Settle reduces token count by 40% with a 0.5-percentage-point decrease in accuracy.

claims.claim: Baseline CoT-Interpretability Alignment across three tasks and three models ranged from forty-four point eight to seventy-five point nine percent.
claims.episode_span: Baseline alignment across three tasks and three models ranged from forty-four point eight to seventy-five point nine percent.
claims.source_title: Making LLMs Say What They Think
claims.supporting_quote: We evaluate CIA on three tasks (two-hop question answering, hint intervention, and integer multiplication) across three LLMs, finding that LLMs exhibit limited alignment across all tasks (44.8-75.9%).

claims.claim: French requires thirty-one to fifty-eight percent more tokens than English across seven 2026 tokenizers.
claims.episode_span: French requires thirty-one to fifty-eight percent more tokens than English across seven 2026 tokenizers.
claims.supporting_quote: French requires 31% to 58% more tokens than English, whereas Simplified Chinese ranges from 5% fewer to 40% more and is cheaper than French on six of the seven tokenizers.
